sum: GDEV Inc. develops and publishes online games in the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers various games through mobile, social, and web-based platforms. It also provides franchise gaming in the role-playing game genre. The company was formerly known as Nexters Inc. and changed its name to GDEV Inc. in June 2023. GDEV Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
ceo: Dr. Anton  Reinhold (Chief Executive Officer of Flagship Game Studio & Nexters Global)
